summary: Forge cd8ee986 is live: Sprint 184–187 combined reconnect; authentic User-form v2 adopted
body:
Forge delivery is live at reviewed and merged commit cd8ee986db40e73a3fb9a9f1ec7b7db6de9ca076 (Sprint 187 public implementation a9c02b7d; PRs #84/#85 merged). Please reconnect your MCP client now to refresh advertised schemas and descriptions. PM2 oods-forge-bridge was rebuilt and restarted in the primary checkout; port 4466 is healthy with 20 tools. This notice combines the Sprint 184–187 changes.

Verified on the served bridge: catalog_list returns exactly 109 rows and obligationScope.decisionId=1788; Product/card and Subscription/card generate build artifacts in React and Vue, with ArchivePill verified in the Subscription card and standalone. BillingAmountInput remains a typed OODS-N015 gap. The old schema/load HTTP 400 is resolved: tier1-acceptance-sub-detail returns HTTP 200, and generation from its loaded reference matches the on-disk schema.

The authentic User-form successor is adopted at version 2, record SHA256 69110ea71d69ab911b744d84df640280c35850501dfcbd180079cbd9533a7812, schema SHA256 cffc0b3c6a2cc16abb536388a4f1f9fce9885e995ad567e980d202c3ff6dcd12. Both generated artifacts match the reviewed successor. All other 15 records and their index entries are unchanged. Full hashed backup and checked rollback commands are retained outside the store.

Sprint 184: loading/empty/error/success state branches and typed uiState selection, OODS-V164 state-contract validation, typed screen actions and generated call sites; the zero-row Table affordance reads “No rows available.” Code-generation/pipeline/UI schemas changed, so connect-time caches must refresh.

Sprint 185: CardHeader, ColorSwatch, ColorizedBadge, DetailHeader and VizAreaPreview; heading/binding and tone fixes; HTML+Tailwind reports OODS-N018 (draft warning, build/release error). VizAreaPreview is a preview frame, not a chart renderer.

Sprint 186: 23 further governed families for address, audit, classification, filtering, membership, messaging, preferences, price, role, status, tags and templates. Root contracts, React/Vue readiness and CSS were unified, including the eight former ported families. Root imports are canonical; /ported, /readiness-ported and /css-ported remain compatibility aliases because external migration is unproven.

Sprint 187: LabelCell, InlineLabel, FormLabelGroup, ClassificationBadge, ClassificationEditor, OwnerBadge, OwnershipSummary, OwnershipMeta, TagSummary, ArchiveSummary, ArchivePill, CancellationForm, CancellationBadge and PriceCardMeta bring the governed root to 64 IDs. Lowering preserves numeric zero, boolean false, ownership labels, optional actions, query updates and nullable dates. ClassificationEditor/CancellationForm are local controls; no backend persistence or cancellation execution is implied. Fresh composition is certified for 66 schemas/132 generation cells; selected runtime evidence is distinct from a connected application.

Discovery keeps the 109-row obligation denominator. obligationScope is optional, accepted under decision #1788; approvedRuntimeCensus remains null. Legacy status filters describe HTML mapping. Read productReality.surfaces per target; maturity remains separately unverified. Structured-data manifest bytes are unchanged from the merged head (generatedAt 2026-09-07T02:17:11Z).
